scope: PS4 installation via PyLoader and PackageFlowService only
changes: PyLoader preview and dispatch no longer require service inventory, firmware or storage APIs
PS4 settings glass card: verifyPkgBeforeSend defaults to false; PARAM/SDK checks remain optional
Tiny PKG <=64KiB requires byte coverage from zero: a tail probe alone is incomplete
PyLoader manifest/HEAD-only idle observation becomes unconfirmed after 30s; active streams are preserved
Explicit package rejection 400/422 and missing never-dispatched ordinary sources release the next queued item
Lost accepted service replies and missing GET receipts keep the same request ID and never replay POST
Current PS4 queue index is saved before asynchronous preflight; early sender failures correctly become failed instead of ghost sending tasks
